concept.title: Negative-Dimensional Topology: What Lives in Dimension -1?
concept.concept_description: Develop a rigorous theory of negative-dimensional spaces using pro-spectra and formal dimension theory. Prove that Euler characteristic extends to negative dimensions and that chi(X) for dim X = -n satisfies chi = (-1)^n · |pi_0(X)|. Formalize the stabilization map from negative to positive dimensions.
